## Description

This is the mechanism that converts optimism bias from a qualitative risk into a mechanically checkable one, and the source of the Kill Criterion for an unsigned-off top-decile-exceeding projection. Use when: "growth projection", "revenue forecast", "base rate warning", "anchor_ref", "hockey stick check".
